class.name: HEGoStrataOutput
class.brief_description: Publishes the heightfields a cook outputs into Strata terrain layers.
class.description: HEGo runs it because it extends [HEGoOutputHandler]; neither HEGo nor Strata names it. A volume names its target with the primitive attribute hegostrata_layer_path, a path resolved like an input path (relative to the HEGo node, or to the edited or running scene); the HDA usually writes it from a target_layer_path parameter. Volumes without it belong to other handlers and are left alone. Every target must be a procedural [StrataLayer] of a [StrataTerrain3D], and every channel the HDA emits for it is accepted. One cook is one [StrataProcedural] transaction over all its targets: every target receives a complete validated result, or none does and each keeps its previous one. The Strata layers the host read as inputs ([HEGoStrataInput]) are the transaction's read set, so a result built from an input that changed while Houdini cooked is rejected, as is one whose target is also one of its inputs. A committed layer records the host in [member StrataLayer.producer_path] and [member StrataLayer.producer_id], the inputs it was built from, and the host's [method signature]; the bridge's editor plugin uses these to mark it stale when the host changes ([method poll]), and Strata itself when an input does.

method.name: should_handle
method.description: Any cook with volumes may carry Strata targets; [method handle] looks for them.

method.name: handle
method.description: Fetches the volumes that name a Strata layer and publishes them as one transaction. A rejected result is logged and recorded on the layers it was meant for, or the layers this host published before when none could be resolved; their previous results stay in place.

method.name: publish
method.description: Routes [param fields], as [method HEGoAssetNode.get_heightfield_fields] returns them, to the layers their hegostrata_layer_path names and publishes them in one transaction by [param host]. [param inputs] are the snapshots the result was built from ([method HEGoStrataInput.snapshot]); [param host_signature] is recorded on every published layer; [param guard], when valid, must still return true at commit. Fields without a target path are ignored. Needs no Houdini session, so tests and fixtures publish through it with fields of their own. Returns the transaction's [code]{ok, message}[/code].

method.name: route_fields
method.description: Groups [param fields] per target layer and converts each to the target terrain's frame. Returns [code]{ok, targets, results}[/code]: [code]targets[/code] as [method StrataProcedural.begin_transaction] takes them, [code]results[/code] as [method StrataProcedural.commit_fields] takes them; or [code]{ok: false, message}[/code].

method.name: record_input
method.description: Records [param snapshot], one Strata input uploaded for this cook, in the shared cook dictionary, so the transaction checks it is still current when it commits.

method.name: producer_id
method.description: The producer identity a publication by [param host] records on its layers: the host's path from the root of the scene it belongs to, or its absolute path when it belongs to none.

method.name: signature
method.description: What a published result depends on in [param host] besides its terrain inputs: the HDA, its parameters (as a hash of [member HEGoNode3D.parm_stash]), its input rows and its transform. Recorded on the layers it publishes as [member StrataLayer.producer_signature].

method.name: producer_changed
method.description: Whether the HEGo node that published [param layer] has changed since: its [method signature] differs from the one recorded on the layer. False when the layer records no producer or its producer is not an HEGo node in the tree.

method.name: published_layers
method.description: The procedural layers under [param root] whose recorded producer is [param host].

method.name: watch
method.description: Makes [param host]'s [signal HEGoNode3D.cook_inputs_changed] mark the layers it published stale at once, rather than at the next [method poll]. Connecting twice does nothing.

method.name: inputs_changed
method.description: Marks every layer [param host] published stale, with new producer intent, because its inputs or parameters changed. Also for layers that are already stale, so a runtime bake of them goes stale too.

method.name: poll
method.description: One pass of the bridge's editor watch over the scene under [param root]: [method watch]es every HEGo node, and marks every current procedural layer stale whose producer changed since it published ([method producer_changed]). The bridge's editor plugin runs this a few times a second; a changed input layer is Strata's own check ([method StrataTerrain3D.check_procedural_sources]).

method.name: to_houdini_attrs
method.description: Strata field metadata as Houdini primitive attributes. Other keys pass through as-is.

method.name: from_houdini_attrs
method.description: Fetched primitive attributes as Strata stores them, with the prefix removed.

constants.constant: Strata stores its field metadata under plain keys (role, channel, ...). In Houdini the same values are primitive attributes with this prefix, so they cannot collide with an HDA's own attributes.
Primitive attributes fetched with every field.
Key the bridge keeps its per-cook state under in the shared cook dictionary ([member HEGoOutputContext.cook_state]): [code]inputs[/code], the snapshots [HEGoStrataInput] uploaded.
Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Status a published layer gets when its producer's inputs or parameters change.
